text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. When tests pass, developers feel more confident that their changes have not broken anything. Without testing, small mistakes can easily become big problems. In short, good testing saves time, reduces stress, and gives teams the confidence to improve their software quickly and safely.
